quote: The driver of a motor vehicle shall not intentionally interfere with the movement of a person lawfully riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter.

activation.condition: A motor-vehicle driver encounters a person riding a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.

obligation.description: Shall not intentionally interfere with movement of a person lawfully riding one of the three named devices.

timing.description: Movement and driver commands are observed across the original rider encounter.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Rider conduct and applicable rules require original source review; no lawful-riding verdict is inferred.
Original commands and movement are observable; intention and interference remain legal judgments without a numeric cutoff.
